title: WebXR
description: Publish WebXR apps for local testing or on the web.

panel.settingsDescription: Choose where to publish your WebXR apps: Localhost for testing on this computer, or Production for your website. Each enabled destination has its own tab below.

config.label: Production configured explicitly
config.hint: Turn on after filling in the destination. Publishing pushes with your Git sign-in; no credentials are stored here.

config.label: Production HTTPS origin
config.hint: The site address, for example https://apps.example.

config.label: Output repository
config.hint: owner/name of the repository whose branch the site serves.

config.label: Output branch
config.hint: The branch the hosting serves the site from.

config.label: Initial branch
config.hint: Creates the output branch from this one if it does not exist yet; use the output branch otherwise.

config.label: Site subtree
config.hint: / or the one repository folder the hosting serves.

config.label: Verification timeout
config.hint: Milliseconds to wait for the published app to become reachable.
